title: Libraries Looked Emptier While Digital Borrowing Hit 739 Million
hook: Libraries looked quieter while digital checkouts hit 739 million.
closing: Readers did not disappear; library use followed them onto their phones.
question: How do you borrow books?

segments.say: Library visits reached 800 million. Buildings remained quieter than before, but readers had not vanished.
Digital library checkouts reached 739 million. Borrowing moved online instead of disappearing.
